info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Meetings Meetings Recordings-v2-spec
info.description: The Meeting Recordings Retrieval API allows developers to access and manage recordings of scheduled meetings. This endpoint provides a list of recordings associated with meetings, enabling users to retrieve essential audio and video files for review or distribution. Typical consumers of this API include application developers and integration specialists looking to enhance productivity tools with meeting documentation features. The API supports efficient retrieval of media content, ensuring that users can easily access past meeting resources for their business requirements.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access and download recordings of meetings, providing a means to review discussions and decisions made during those meetings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the recording details of a specific meeting. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included in the request to get accurate results.
